performance.verdict: CPL at $11.90 is efficient, but pipeline conversion is broken — ads are not the problem.

findings.text: OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved — 122 leads over 28 days cannot be traced to appointments or patients.
OVERDUE: Renewal closed 2026-07-23 triggering a prove-it month — scoreboard (leads → scheduled → shown → new patients) has no functional tracking bridge yet.

CPL improved to $11.90 (28d) with a 26% drop week-over-week, but 3-day spend signal is soft: $18.51→$41.10→$34.85 vs prior 3-day $21.11→$42.59→$64.90 — volume compressing without efficiency gain sustaining it.
GHL pipeline shows 81 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments logged against 122 leads — intake leak confirmed, not an ads problem.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for three consecutive days (Aug 15–17) after a peak of 25 on Aug 14 — organic floor may be losing ground during a high-stakes prove-it month.
